standard-dialogue.npc: How do. You planning on crossing this here bridge and heading up to Rellekka then?

steps.npc: Aye, 'tis a good thing we fixed this 'ere bridge, I reckon. You best be careful up there. Them Fremenniks are odd 'uns.

steps.player: So you fixed this bridge yourself?

steps.npc: Aye, that I did. 'Twas real thirsty work too. If only some kind stranger would buy us a bit of beer to sup, eh?
What with that inn at seers so close by and all, eh?
Just make sure yer don't get me none of that non alcoholic rubbish from that poison salesman guy at the tavern!

steps.player: I wasn't planning on it, no.

steps.npc: Aye, that's what I told t'gaffer. Nobody wants to go up and hang out with a buncha dumb barbarians when there's a perfectly good inn to sup in, in t'seers village.
Ain't much better in life than having a nice cold beer to sup on a hot day like this, eh? Better'n fixing bridges, eh?
Just make sure yer don't get me none of that non alcoholic rubbish from that poison salesman guy at the tavern!

standard-dialogue-when-using-a-beer-or-b.npc: A bit early in the day fer that ain't it?
Ta very much, like. That'll hit the spot nicely. Here, you can have this. I picked it up as a souvenir on me last hols.
I dunno rightly, but if you use a tinderbox on it, it don't half make a loud noise!

standard-dialogue-when-using-another-typ.npc: No ta, not my brand of beer.

standard-dialogue-when-using-a-jug-of-wi.npc: No ta, not a big wine fan, me.

standard-dialogue-when-using-a-bottled-d.npc: A bit early in the day fer that ain't it?
